notes.title: v1.7.0 Updates
notes.content:
New Features:
1.Legion Assistance System – Now available for legions, allowing players to earn up to S+ quality tank blueprints.
2. Hyper Equipment – Unlocked at level 100, this new equipment tier includes a full suite of crafting features: Casting Shop, Component Crafting, Hyper Enchancement, Recasting, and Recycling.
3. New Attribute - Resistance – Reduces incoming damage and can be boosted through Hyper Equipment upgrades.
4. Cross-server Exercise – Dive into immersive training exercises for additional rewards.
5. Battle Pass System – A new Battle Pass system packed with rewards for active players.
6. Top Tank & Commander Leaderboards – Updated nightly at 21:00 for real-time ranking.
7. New Tanks and Commanders – Fresh additions to the roster of tanks and commanders.
8. Titanium Tank Modification – Unlock powerful upgrades for tank skills with Titanium Modifications, available for specific models: Deceiver, Sabretooth, Thundercloud, Shadow-X, Blaze Citadel, Ratzilla P1000, Vengeance, PLZ-05B, Tornado, Red Flag, and Redoubt.
9. SS class Tank Acquisition in tank Research – The Tank Research system now includes new methods to acquire SS class tanks (with previous drawing progress reset).
10. Universal Molds – Now available in the Tank Research Exchange for redeeming SS class tank shards.
11. New Daily and Weekly Limited Purchase Packs – Available in the shop.
12. First-Purchase Rewards Updated – Improved rewards for first-time purchases.
13. Reduced gem Cost for Enemy Searches in World Conquest – Reduced gem cost for locating enemy players.
14. Winning Streak Fatigue in World Conquest – In consecutive battles within the same zone, units will weaken progressively, but this does not apply when defending their own base. 
15. Increased gem Cost for Reviving Units – Costs gradually increase after a certain number of revives.

Optimizations:

1. World Boss Improvements – Players can now enter the World Boss screen 2 hours early, enabling auto-battle settings to participate even while offline.
2. City Abandonment Timer Reduced – From 12 hours down to 8 hours.
3. UI Adjustments for World Conquest – Enhanced visual and layout elements.
4. World Conquest Mechanics Tweaked:
   1) Added Resource Protection Tech to prevent resource theft.
   2) Weekly siege rewards now have a collection limit, with bonus rewards in specific cities.
   3) Resource Decay for Inactive Players – Reduced production for those offline for more than 10 days.
   4) Daily Raid Cap – Limits the number of rewards from enemy raids per day.
   5) New Shield Item for bases, earnable via Conquest tasks and monthly logins.
   6)High-level Commanders in the World Conquest store now visible at level 90.
5. Enhanced Chat Options – Increased free messages to 20 daily for global chat and 10 for cross-server chat.
6. System – Added an account login option on the update screen for easier account access.
7. Backpack Interface Update – Improved display for easier inventory management.
8. Skill Adjustments – Enhanced abilities for Deceiver, Baroque Airship, Chrono Tank, PZH-2000, and 99A.
9. Combat Mechanics – Unit health in World Conquest now remains consistent with their pre-battle health.
10. Cooldown Adjustment for Commander Ultimates – All defensive commanders now have a 30-second ultimate cooldown.
11. Tank Rewards in Limited-Time Draws – Increased value of limited-time tank draws with new mechanics for guaranteed tank rewards.
12. Map Zoom Functionality – Zoom in and out with the scroll wheel on all World Conquest and battle maps.
13. Updated Visuals – Enhanced graphics, icons, and maps.
14. Other Optimizations – Minor improvements for smoother gameplay.

Bug Fixes:

1.Fixed a naming error in Elvira’s skill description.
2. Corrected HP values for Legion Bosses: Scavenger, Emperor’s Blade, Emperor’s Venom, and B2 740(f).
3. Resolved continuous typing sound bug in chapter descriptions after stage completion.
4. Fixed incorrect time display for Conquest techs with over 1 day remaining.
5. Corrected typos in some Commander skill descriptions.
6. Resolved chip system bug causing power mismatch.
7. Fixed potential crash issue in initial ladder battles.

notes.title: Ver 1.7.0 Update Preview
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Version 1.7.0 of our game Clash of Irons will be rolling out very soon! This long-awaited update brings a host of new features and improvements over the previous version.
Here are what you will get for this update:
New Features:
1.Legion Assistance System – Now available for legions, allowing players to earn up to S+ quality tank blueprints.
2. Hyper Equipment – Unlocked at level 100, this new equipment tier includes a full suite of crafting features: Casting Shop, Component Crafting, Hyper Enchancement, Recasting, and Recycling.
3. New Attribute - Resistance – Reduces incoming damage and can be boosted through Hyper Equipment upgrades.
4. Cross-server Exercise – Dive into immersive war exercises for additional rewards.
5. Battle Pass System – A new Battle Pass system packed with rewards for active players.
6. Top Tank & Commander Leaderboards – Updated nightly at 21:00 for real-time ranking.
7. New Tanks and Commanders – Fresh additions to the roster of tanks and commanders.
8. Titanium Tank Modification – Unlock powerful upgrades for tank skills with Titanium Modifications, available for specific models: Deceiver, Sabretooth, Thundercloud, Shadow-X, Blaze Citadel, Ratzilla P1000, Vengeance, PLZ-05B, Tornado, Red Flag, and Redoubt.
9. SS class Tank Acquisition in tank Research – The Tank Research system now includes new methods to acquire SS class tanks (with previous drawing progress reset).
10. Universal Molds – Now available in the Tank Research Exchange for redeeming SS class tank shards.
11. New Daily and Weekly Limited Purchase Packs – Available in the shop.
12. First-Purchase Rewards Updated – Improved rewards for first-time purchases.
13. Reduced gem Cost for Enemy Searches in World Conquest – Reduced gem cost for locating enemy players.
14. Winning Streak Fatigue in World Conquest – In consecutive battles within the same zone, units will weaken progressively, but this does not apply when defending their own base.
15. Increased gem Cost for Reviving Units – Costs gradually increase after a certain number of revives.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40000693/9297cbd67f4fd383e927e42e379059ab1cbf70bf.gif[/img]
In addition to the new feature mentioned above, there are also numerous improvements and fixes to existing features and systems. Take a look below!
Optimizations:
1. World Boss Improvements – Players can now enter the World Boss screen 2 hours early, enabling auto-battle settings to participate even while offline.
2. City Abandonment Timer Reduced – From 12 hours down to 8 hours.
3. UI Adjustments for World Conquest – Enhanced visual and layout elements.
4. World Conquest Mechanics Tweaked:
   (1) Added Resource Protection Tech to prevent resource theft.
   (2) Weekly siege rewards now have a collection limit, with bonus rewards in specific cities.
   (3) Resource Decay for Inactive Players – Reduced production for those offline for more than 10 days.
   (4) Daily Raid Cap – Limits the number of rewards from enemy raids per day.
   (5) New Shield Item for bases, earnable via Conquest tasks and monthly logins.
   (6)High-level Commanders in the World Conquest store now visible at level 90.
5. Enhanced Chat Options – Increased free messages to 20 daily for global chat and 10 for cross-server chat.
6. System – Added an account login option on the update screen for easier account access.
7. Backpack Interface Update – Improved display for easier inventory management.
8. Skill Adjustments – Enhanced abilities for Deceiver, Megalodon, Matrix, PZH-2000, and Type 99A.
9. Combat Mechanics – The HP of units in World Conquest now remains consistent with their pre-battle HP.
10. Cooldown Adjustment for Commander Ultimates – All defensive commanders now have a 30-second ultimate cooldown.
11. Tank Rewards in Limited-Time Draws – Increased value of limited-time tank draws with new mechanics for guaranteed tank rewards.
12. Map Zoom Functionality – Zoom in and out with the scroll wheel on all World Conquest and battle maps.
13. Updated Visuals – Enhanced graphics, icons, and maps.
14. Other Optimizations – Minor improvements for smoother gameplay.
Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed a naming error in Elvira’s skill description.
2. Corrected HP values for Legion Bosses: Scavenger, Emperor’s Blade, Emperor’s Venom, and B2 740(f).
3. Resolved continuous typing sound bug in chapter descriptions after stage completion.
4. Fixed incorrect time display for Conquest techs with over 1 day remaining.
5. Corrected typos in some Commander skill descriptions.
6. Resolved chip system bug causing power mismatch.
7. Fixed potential crash issue in initial ladder battles.

This update is packed with exciting new features and improvements designed to make gameplay even more immersive for all commanders. We've carefully crafted these additions to enhance your experience and bring more depth and excitement to every mission. Whether you're strategizing or diving into combat, the fresh updates will provide new ways to engage and elevate your journey in the game!

notes.title: Update for Ver. 1.6.300 on Feb. 15 of 2022
notes.content:
1. Chip and Core released
2. Cross-Server Rank Tournament Arena (RTA) released
3. Cross-Server Legion Wars released
4. Cross-Server Chat released
5. Tank Album system released
6. Fame of Hall system released
7. Capital City War released

Other new feature:
1. Powerful new SS tanks increased
2. Powerful new Commanders increased
2. New Unique Insignia Set increased
3. Higher stage cap for Battle of Kursk unlock (Up to Stage 240)

Other minor changes:
1. Incorporated 50 VIP exp in the Lv.20 Pack
2. Removed the VIP exp in daily quest rewards


Some more details of the new features you may want to know

A: What are Cross-Server Tournament Arena
Q: Cross-Server Rank Tournament Arena aka RTA, is a cross-server Arena where players from different servers can match and spar with each other. By promoting the RTA rank, you will be able to receive bountiful rewards such as the newly released chips and cores. There are also more interesting features with the RTA that will make the battles more chanlleging and fun.

Q: What are Chips and Cores?
A: Chip and Cores are basically an additional kind of accessory for your tanks, they provide different attributes and unique core skills to your tanks that can boost the capability of your vehicles, provide more strategic options for your formations hence to better tackle for different enemies.

Q: When is Chip and Core Available?
A: After the update is live, every player at Lv.55 or higher will be able to unlock the Chip and Core feature as soon as they promote their RTA rank to Bronze III.

Q: How is Capital City War played?
A: It's basically an upgraded version of the World Conquest War where Berlin is unlocked for capture. Many players have asked for it and now you will have it.

Q: How helpful is the Tank Album to the winning of battles?
A: Tank Album has included all illustrations of Tanks that you already owned, you can upgrade the star level of tank illustrations with a special item called Time Films. Although it does not directly increase your power rating, it empowers your units with additional augments during the battle. If you want to take the upper hand in battles, you'd better don't miss it out. 

Q: What can I get from the Hall of Fame? What is needed for the eligibility
A: You will harvest reputation and your supporters will receive bountiful rewards if you'd be listed in the Hall of Fame. To achieve this, you will need to champion in the RTA for as many times as possible. Other metrics may also be added into the algorithm in the future. Stay tuned!
